title: 第74章 恶魔在人间

第74章 恶魔在人间-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

李月芽其实也没打算真让吴姜去，只是随口一提，可听到吴姜毫不犹豫的拒绝，还是气得半死，但拿吴姜却没有丝毫办法，只能暗地里骂他“木头疙瘩”“不解风情”，准备回去就找王姨告状。

这天下午，吴姜正在赵安坤的坐馆里喝茶，最近一有时间他就过来，听赵安坤吹嘘他当了几十年鬼差，碰到的奇人异事。

吴姜爱听这些，赵安坤有了一个好听众，他也爱讲。

正听的津津有味的时候，手机就突然响了，来电显示是小牛鼻子，是云川的电话。

接通电话后，云川的声音格外低沉，带着一丝难以掩饰的失落：“吴姜，出大事了！”

吴姜心里一沉，连忙问道：“怎么了？是不是恶鬼出现了？”

等云川讲完，吴姜的脸上浮现出了震惊的神色，手中的茶杯差点摔在地上。

一个偏远的山村，一夜之间，被那只恶鬼屠戮一空，全村上下，没有一个活口，等茅山和龙虎山的人赶到的时候，恶鬼已经重新回到鬼将境了。

最后，在两派高手的围攻下，虽然将恶鬼打伤了，但最后还是被恶鬼给逃了。

吴姜实在不敢相信，和平时期，居然会发生这样的惨案。

之前他们都以为，那只恶鬼会去茅山报仇，殊不知在恶鬼的心中，他又不是傻子，就算他现在是鬼将境了，去了茅山祖庭，那也是送菜去的。

打杀落单的，它不香吗？

接下来的事情，就不是吴姜能管的了，茅山已经动了真格的，不仅召集了门派里的高手，还从地府请了一位祖师爷上来，势必要将这只恶鬼捉拿归案。

只是，即便能将恶鬼绳之以法，打入十八层地狱，那个山村的村民也回不来了，他们的魂魄，已经被恶鬼彻底吞噬干净，连投胎转世的机会都没有了。

吴姜一连抑郁了好几天才才慢慢缓解过来，他第一次真切地感受到，阴差的责任有多么重大，也第一次明白，邪祟的残忍，远超他的想象。

晚上，吴姜正在和李月芽视频聊天，她旅游也快结束了，此刻正在问吴姜想要什么礼物。

Li Yueya actually didn't intend to let Wu Jiang go, she just mentioned it casually, but when she heard Wu Jiang's refusal without hesitation, she was still angry to death, but she had no way to deal with Wu Jiang. She could only secretly scold him as "a lump of wood" and "unintelligible", and planned to complain to Aunt Wang when he returned.

That afternoon, Wu Jiang was drinking tea in Zhao Ankun's restaurant. He came over whenever he had time recently and listened to Zhao Ankun bragging about the strange people and strange things he had encountered while working as a ghost for decades.

Wu Jiang liked to hear these things, and Zhao Ankun had a good audience, so he also liked to talk.

While I was listening with great interest, my phone suddenly rang. The caller ID showed Maverick Nose, and it was Yunchuan's phone number.

After answering the phone, Yunchuan's voice was extremely low, with a hint of disappointment that was difficult to conceal: "Wu Jiang, something big happened!"

Wu Jiang's heart sank and he quickly asked: "What's wrong? Has an evil spirit appeared?"

When Yun Chuan finished speaking, Wu Jiang had a look of shock on his face, and the tea cup in his hand almost fell to the ground.

A remote mountain village was slaughtered by the evil ghost overnight. There was no one left alive in the whole village. By the time the people from Maoshan and Longhu Mountain arrived, the evil ghost had returned to the ghost general realm again.

In the end, under the siege of the masters of the two factions, although the evil ghost was injured, the evil ghost finally escaped.

Wu Jiang really couldn't believe that such a tragedy would happen during peacetime.

Before, they all thought that the evil ghost would go to Maoshan to take revenge. However, in the evil ghost's heart, he was not a fool. Even if he was now in the Ghost General realm, he would still be delivering food to the Maoshan Ancestral Court.

Isn’t it delicious to kill the lone ones?

What happens next is beyond Wu Jiang's control. Maoshan has taken serious action. Not only has he summoned the masters of the sect, he has also invited a master from the underworld to come up, so that this evil ghost must be captured and brought to justice.

However, even if the evil ghost can be brought to justice and sent to the eighteenth level of hell, the villagers of that mountain village will not be able to come back. Their souls have been completely devoured by the evil ghost, and they have no chance of reincarnation.

Wu Jiang was depressed for several days before he slowly recovered. For the first time, he truly felt how important the responsibility of evil was, and for the first time he understood that the evil was far more cruel than he imagined.

In the evening, Wu Jiang was video chatting with Li Yueya. Her trip was about to end, and she was asking Wu Jiang what gift she wanted.
